title: interview-process
description: Root node for the proposal to add an agent-user interview process between proposal and requirements/design planning.

title: Proposal workflow skill
description: Defines proposal creation, scope gate, ADR metadata, and Next Artifacts guidance. The interview process will likely become a new handoff after proposal acceptance and before requirements/design artifact creation.

title: Plan workflow skill
description: Consumes proposal, map, facts, requirements, and design artifacts. The interview process must feed requirements/design inputs before this skill drafts implementation phases.

title: Implementation workflow skill
description: Implementation remains downstream of proposal, requirements/design, and plan; interview decisions should prevent ambiguous implementation phases.

title: Requirements records helper
description: Manages durable requirements initialization/folding; interview outputs should become topic-local requirement deltas that later fold into durable requirements docs.

title: Planning graph validator
description: Validates plan/requirements/design graph artifacts. Interview output should be validated through these downstream graph checks once requirements/design artifacts exist.

title: Cartographer Pi extension tools
description: Registers Cartographer wrapper tools. Future interview-specific deterministic helpers or UI preview tools could live behind this extension boundary.

title: Cartographer README workflow docs
description: Documents the proposal → requirements delta → design → plan → implement workflow and dashboard behavior; should be updated if the accepted process adds an interview gate.

title: ADR-0007 proposal/design/requirements split
description: Accepted architecture decision requiring proposals to stay lightweight and scoped changes to use requirements/design artifacts before planning.

title: ADR-0003 dashboard UI stack
description: Records existing local dashboard/browser/Playwright UI stack choices that can inform optional mockup preview implementation.

title: Package manifest and scripts
description: Declares Pi extension packaging, Playwright/browser test dependencies, and validation scripts relevant to implementing interview preview tooling.

title: Workflow documentation tests
description: Asserts proposal/requirements/design split documentation and should gain coverage for any accepted interview-gate documentation changes.

title: Planning graph validator tests
description: Covers requirements and design graph validation behavior that interview output must ultimately satisfy.

title: Dashboard dialog UI primitive
description: Existing shadcn/Radix dialog component that may inform browser/dashboard-side mockup review UI if the feature goes beyond TUI-only interactions.
